seed.title: First graduate of the week
seed.description: Graduate: finish the three founding quests and seal your Passport at Bloq's shop. The chain checks it; the board pays at once.

seed.title: Today's quest, done
seed.description: Complete the daily quest written by the AI agent (daily-2026-11-05). Paid by the board from the DAO's allowance.

seed.title: Teach one newcomer
seed.description: Reach Passport level 3, then write a three-line explanation of gas for a newcomer and post it as a comment on the DAO proposal the board files for you. The council pays with one vote.

seed.title: Run a Bloqvia session
seed.description: Graduates only: host a 30-minute session for newcomers and bring three of them to the map. Large reward: the board certifies that you qualified; the payment goes through the DAO's normal proposal.
